scripts.dev:web: node scripts/run-with-dotenvx.mjs web --workspace web run dev
scripts.dev:worker: node scripts/run-with-dotenvx.mjs worker --workspace worker run dev
scripts.start:web: node scripts/run-with-dotenvx.mjs web --workspace web run start
scripts.start:worker: node scripts/run-with-dotenvx.mjs worker --workspace worker run start
scripts.db:migrate: node scripts/run-with-dotenvx.mjs web --workspace web exec prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:seed: node scripts/run-with-dotenvx.mjs web --workspace web exec prisma db seed
